procedure: Require source TRAINING_PAUSED.json and digest-bound step-1 checkpoint receipt bound to the exact source plan; verify a finite update, complete 32-rank checkpoint and stable source files.
Seal the trusted checkpoint once in a zero-GPU CPU Job; hash every native model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG and sampler payload into a new immutable manifest outside the checkpoint.
Compile a separate restore-only plan with the exact sealed manifest and new run/output/W&B identity; keep model, datasets, recipe, image and 4x8 topology unchanged.
Run exact-image zero-GPU preflight and server-preview the rendered root RayJob; require duplicate/output/capacity checks before one create-once POST.

On all 32 ranks, load the exact model, optimizer and scheduler plus the saved sampler; compare rank coverage, optimizer counters and sampler state; execute zero forward/backward/optimizer steps and emit a digest-bound RELOAD_VALIDATED.json.
Verify source checkpoint hashes unchanged and release the exact owned reload allocation.
why_not_generic_validate: Source validation_mode=task_outcomes_only has no dev split. The pinned generic recovery.mode=validate path requires a CE dev artifact; adding one would violate sealed source dataset identity. A narrowly scoped restore-only path is required.
remaining_blockers: The step-1 checkpoint and manifest do not exist until the v2 capacity canary succeeds.
Restore-only runtime/plan adapter is not yet implemented or exact-image preflighted; this design does not authorize a reload GPU POST.
Root must separately review the exact reload request and rendered root alert annotation before launch.
